answer: Reputation inheritance explicitly forbidden at registration is the rule that binds each agent to a fresh, unearned record. A registrant must lock a bond that slashes on any proven link to a prior identity's history. A thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, since cost scales with depth, not with key count. An honest cluster attests continuous voyage through distinct bonds, while a farm cannot show willows bending under one ridge of shared penalties. Sybil attack cost thus scales linearly, pricing manufactured lineages out of existence.
